prompt:
Perform a limited observational visual audit, in English, at most 900 words. The three native image attachments are actual historical source/render images, unedited. Separate directly visible 2D observations from hypotheses about 3D geometry or code. Image appearance alone cannot establish physical connectivity, object counts behind occlusion, correctness of hidden geometry, teacher diagnosis, or student adoption. Do not infer all experiments from this case. No numeric automated score or causal advantage claim. Cite image numbers and describe evidence for each observed concern.
Image order: original office photograph, initial stage-1 room/viewpoint render, stage-1 visual-revision render. This stage intentionally omits furniture. Compare camera, room shell, illumination, image borders and projection. Do not criticize missing later-stage objects as a failure of this stage.
